text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made her debut, Sirius Symboli set 
her next target on the Saudi Arabia Royal 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why choose the very race where Symboli 
Rudolf had once claimed a sweeping victory 
and shown a glimpse of her transcendent 
strength?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli left on her own without 
revealing her intentions.
